name: Wall Finishes
tagline: Panels, papers and plasters that give a flat wall depth
description: Paint covers a wall; these finishes give it character. Fluted and 3D panels add shadow, wallpaper adds pattern, microcement and Venetian plaster add craft. Most of this section is about how a wall catches light at six in the evening.

materials.name: Wallpaper
materials.blurb: Rolls of pattern — the fastest transformation in interiors
materials.description: A 5.2 sq.m roll and a day's labour will change a room more than anything else at the price. Non-woven papers are the easiest to hang and to strip later, which matters in rented homes.

materials.name: Fabric wall covering
materials.blurb: Upholstered walls — acoustic softness with real texture
materials.description: Fabric stretched over a padded backing absorbs sound and gives a hotel-suite softness. Used on bedbacks and home theatres; it collects dust, so specify a treated fabric.

materials.name: 3D wall panel
materials.blurb: Moulded relief panels that read as sculpture under grazing light
materials.description: PVC, gypsum or MDF panels with a deep relief pattern. They only work with the right lighting — wash them from above or the whole effect flattens out.

materials.name: Fluted panel
materials.blurb: Vertical timber battens — the defining detail of the decade
materials.description: Ribbed MDF or solid timber slats that add rhythm and hide imperfect walls. Available as veneered, laminated or acoustic-backed panels in 2.4 m and 2.9 m lengths.

materials.name: WPC wall panel
materials.blurb: Waterproof composite cladding, indoors or out
materials.description: Wood-plastic composite panels that will not rot, warp or feed termites — so they work on balcony walls and bathroom exteriors where MDF cannot go.

materials.name: PVC wall panel
materials.blurb: The budget wet-area cladding — light and wipe-clean
materials.description: Hollow PVC sheets that clip together over battens. Cheap, fast and waterproof; also unmistakably plastic up close, so keep it to service areas and rentals.

materials.name: Charcoal panel
materials.blurb: Bamboo-charcoal composite — low-VOC and lightly acoustic
materials.description: Extruded bamboo charcoal panels marketed for low emissions and odour absorption, usually in fluted profiles. Fast to install with adhesive and popular in quick residential upgrades.

materials.name: Wood wall panelling
materials.blurb: Classic framed or slatted timber panelling
materials.description: From traditional stile-and-rail panelling to modern slat systems in veneer or solid timber. The most convincing way to give a new apartment some architectural weight.

materials.name: Microcement
materials.blurb: Seamless 2–3 mm cement skin over almost any substrate
materials.description: A thin polymer-cement coat applied by hand, giving continuous floors, walls and even counters with no joints. Highly skill-dependent — insist on the applicator's previous work.

materials.name: Textured paint
materials.blurb: Trowelled and rolled effects — stucco, sand, combed
materials.description: Thick decorative coatings applied with a trowel, roller or comb. Far cheaper than panelling for adding surface interest, and easily patched compared with wallpaper.

materials.name: Venetian plaster
materials.blurb: Polished lime plaster with depth and a marble-like sheen
materials.description: Layered lime and marble dust burnished to a soft glow that changes with the light. Genuinely handmade, genuinely expensive, and unmatched in a formal room.

materials.name: Stone cladding
materials.blurb: Natural stone strips and ledges for feature and façade walls
materials.description: Split-face stone in strips or ledger panels gives strong shadow and texture. Heavy — confirm the wall and the fixing detail before it goes on the drawing.

materials.name: Brick cladding
materials.blurb: Thin brick slips for exposed-brick looks without the wall
materials.description: 20–25 mm brick slips glued to the wall give the texture of exposed brick at a fraction of the thickness and weight. Seal them if they are anywhere near a kitchen.
